core_obligations: Identify the objects (proof lines 9357-9364): a central simple algebra of degree d over K becomes isomorphic to the matrix algebra M_d after extending scalars to the separable closure, with automorphism group PGL_d.

Apply descent (proof lines 9364-9371): twisted forms of the matrix algebra are classified by the first non-abelian cohomology of the Galois group with coefficients in PGL_d, which gives the asserted bijection of sets of isomorphism classes.
proof_roadmap: Observe that a central simple algebra of degree d is a form of the matrix algebra.
Its automorphism group after base change is PGL_d.
Apply the classification of twisted forms by non-abelian H^1 to obtain the bijection.
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the isomorphism classes of central simple algebras of degree d over a field with the first non-abelian cohomology of the absolute Galois group with coefficients in PGL_d (statement lines 9346-9355, whose slogan line is delivered as written since the chapter's preamble defines the slogan environment as a comment). The proof observes that such an algebra becomes the matrix algebra after extending scalars, with automorphism group PGL_d (proof lines 9357-9364), and applies the classification of twisted forms by non-abelian cohomology (proof lines 9364-9371). The non-formal content is the identification of the forms and their automorphism group. The claim is H2: one identification plus one classification statement.
